observations: Large automotive automatic transmission with an attached transfer case.
The unit is heavily soiled with dirt and grime, stored on the ground.
A yellow paint mark is visible on the bell housing, common in salvage yards.
Electrical connectors and fluid lines are visible but disconnected.
No manufacturer identification tags or stamped codes are legible in the photos.

claims.evidence: Requires high-resolution close-ups of the casing bolts to check for tool marks or disturbed sealant.

risks.proof: A video of the unit being tested or a functional guarantee from the seller.
A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate or stamped model code.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the identification plate or stamped model number on the transmission casing.
Close-up photos of the bolts on the main casing and transfer case.
Photo of the transmission fluid on a white cloth to check for burnt residue.
response.reason: The specific model and vehicle compatibility cannot be confirmed without a photo of the identification plate. This information is essential for accurate pricing.
